mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled, l.code AS location_code FROM wms_assembly_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = i.location_id WHERE i.assembly_id = #{assemblyId} ORDER BY i.id
